title: On-chain works
sourceAttribution: Chain-verified holdings of the collector's three wallets (thingelstad.eth, nnxyz.thingelstad.eth, niftyink.thingelstad.eth) read 2026-10-16; originals fetched from each token's metadata (IPFS) and hashed. Draft: not referenced from src/.
notes: alreadyInSite marks the 52 Abstract tokens that data/abstract.json already carries (same id). Their originals fetched from IPFS are byte-identical to the JPEGs recorded there (same SHA-256 for all 52).
reissueOf marks a token on a later contract that copies an earlier one with the same token id; the collector holds both, so the pair is one work.
acquisitionPrice is what the transaction paid in total; acquisitionPricePerToken divides it when one transaction bought several tokens.
